newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends up vs dlr, steady vs NBH basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends up vs dlr, steady vs NBH basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed a shade firmer against the dollar, pushed up by the mark's gains versus the U.S. currency, dealers said
The forint closed at 181.15/20 to the dollar, compared with its opening of 181.28/23.
"We followed the dollar/mark," said Szabolcs Brezina of Kereskedelmi Bank, adding that the forint remained pinned to the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) floating resistance level (bid.)
Dealers said they did not foresee events which could make the forint drift away from the NBH bid substantially.
However, speculation on the movements of the dollar/mark may ease the forint by a few pips temporarily next week, when the U.S. may raise its interest rates, dealers said.
(NBH basket: 30 percent dollar + 70 percent mark. The NBH's intervention range is 4.5 percent wide.)
